posts.name: OpenSwarm
posts.tagline: A swarm of agents, in the same place you work
posts.description: Stop bolting AI onto your computer. OpenSwarm is an AI-first operating system where agents run the whole machine: apps create themselves, browsers control themselves, and swarms of agents work together. Your OS just became an infinite canvas, and your work just transformed from you doing one task at a time, to orchestrating dozens in parallel. Tell it what you want and a swarm of agents does the work with you at the helm.

posts.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
posts.tagline: Anthropic's fastest and most capable Haiku yet
posts.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is Anthropic's fastest and most capable small model, built for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summarization, classification, coding subagents, customer support, and browser use.

posts.name: OpenSEO
posts.tagline: The open source Semrush alternative
posts.description: Without good data, your agent gives generic advice. We provide the data, tools, and integrations your AI agent needs for SEO via MCP. Regular SEO is the foundation of good GEO, but we just released a new set of AI Visibility features as well.

posts.name: Griffin by Tavus
posts.tagline: World's First Human Interaction Model
posts.description: Griffin is Tavus’s Human Interaction Model for face-to-face, real-time conversation. It sees, hears, and talks at the same time, responding to pauses, expressions, gestures, and what’s happening on camera. In a live one-minute video call, 48% of participants believed they were talking to a real person. Griffin-Lite is available as a research preview to select early testers, with full-duplex video-to-video interaction and 720p generation.

posts.name: ChickyTutor
posts.tagline: A private language tutor that knows you better every day.
posts.description: Hi Product Hunt! I’m Phanos, founder of ChickyTutor. We’re returning with an interactive whiteboard that brings visual teaching into spoken language practice. Ask about a language pattern, see examples, work through an exercise and discuss it with your tutor all during the conversation. We’ve also partnered with L’école de français to combine teacher-led French classes with daily AI practice between lessons at chickytutor.com/hybrid/french, and released ChickyTutor on Android.

posts.name: Cekura Bench
posts.tagline: Speech-to-speech model benchmarks on live phone calls
posts.description: Cekura Bench publishes voice AI benchmarks you can verify. Our new speech-to-speech benchmark tests 9 realtime voice models, including GPT Realtime 2.1, Gemini Live, Grok and Phonic, as complete phone agents on live calls: 82 scenarios, three runs each. Models are ranked on reliability, data accuracy, stalled calls, response time and cost, and every call transcript is public. Cekura Bench also covers voice agent benchmarks and STT benchmarks, with TTS benchmarks coming soon.

posts.name: KloudMate 2.0
posts.tagline: AI-powered Full-Stack Observability & Agentic SRE-Ops
posts.description: 3 years after launching as an AWS serverless monitoring tool, KloudMate returns to PH as a full-stack, AI-powered Observability & Agentic SRE-Ops platform. It unifies metrics, logs, traces, and more, while KloudMate AI helps teams investigate incidents, find root causes, and resolve tickets. From dashboards to instant answers, KloudMate is built for modern, distributed systems. KloudMate AI Modules - Assistant (Answers), Builder (Dashboards, Alarms), Investigator (RCA), Docs (Documentation).

posts.name: NOVA CLI v1.0
posts.tagline: AI developer in your terminal
posts.description: Nova CLI is an AI teammate in your terminal. Describe what you want in plain words and Nova reads your project, makes the change, runs your own tests and build, fixes what it broke, and gives you an honest verdict on what it checked. 160+ AI models are included on paid plans, with no separate AI account or API keys to manage. It works with the tests and tooling you already have, so there is nothing new to set up. Try Nova for free and see what it can do for your next task, here in your terminal.

posts.name: Claude for Google Workspace
posts.tagline: Bring Claude directly into Google Docs, Sheets & Slides
posts.description: Claude now works directly inside Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Ask it to draft and edit documents, analyze spreadsheets, write formulas, build charts, or create presentation slides — all without leaving your file. You can also create and edit Google Workspace files directly from Claude using the new connectors. No more copying and pasting between apps. Available in beta for all paid Claude plans.

posts.name: Polylane for Vercel
posts.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Vercel apps
posts.description: Keep shipping while Polylane watches your Vercel apps. Connect through the Vercel Marketplace to bring projects, deployments, domains and logs into one live graph. Agents catch regressions, investigate the root cause with evidence, and open a pull request with the permanent fix for your review.

posts.name: Paw-Paw
posts.tagline: A tiny desktop pet for your Mac that types along with you
posts.description: A small illustrated animal sits in the corner of your Mac's screen, reacts as you type and click, and naps when you pause. Choose which season earns XP and unlock dozens of Paw-Paws and 100+ items as you level up. Free and native; one optional $2.99 add-on.

posts.name: Off the Record
posts.tagline: Block AI from transcribing your meetings.
posts.description: Off the Record reshapes your voice in real time so people can understand you while AI notetakers and hidden interview copilots struggle to transcribe it.

posts.name: Hark
posts.tagline: The personal AI that handles life before you have to
posts.description: Hark Pro is a personal AI designed to take things off your plate, not add another chatbot to your day. It remembers what matters, thinks ahead about what you might need, and uses its own cloud computer to get things done across the web — from managing calendars and email to shopping, travel, bills, and everyday errands. Your sensitive credentials stay encrypted, Hark never sells your data or shares it with advertisers, and you can watch it work.

posts.name: tide
posts.tagline: A Jitsi alternative that does a few things really well
posts.description: tide is a simple, self‑hostable video conference service, alternative to Jitsi. It let's you host your own "meet.custom.domain" for a simple video conferencing environment with all core features you expect, including: link sharing, screen sharing, recording (server-side). A few things, done well.

posts.name: Liquid Inference
posts.tagline: LLM router where providers compete for every prompt
posts.description: * Fully compatible with agentic coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Pi, Cline, and many more. Full multi-modal support. * Hundreds of open- and closed-weight models. Create routing rule presets or use our Auto routing algorithms. * Providers compete dynamically on price for every prompt, offering the lowest marginal cost. * Sign up for free with email, first 500 users get $20 of free inference. Receive 20% of referred fees as free inference, 10% for second-level referrals.

posts.name: Markdoc
posts.tagline: A shared Markdown editor for people and their agents
posts.description: Write Markdown with the source and an editable preview side by side, live for everyone in the document. Review with comments and suggestions, bring your own agent over MCP, and publish straight to a gist or a repository file.

posts.name: BotBus
posts.tagline: Manage your local coding agents from your phone
posts.description: BotBus connects local coding agents to your phone. Manage Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness and more across computers. Continue supported tasks, handle approvals, view files and PDFs, and use a terminal. macOS adds screen control and shared web previews. Hosts: macOS, Linux, Windows. Mobile: iPhone, Apple Watch, Android APK. Your computer stays online; capabilities vary by connector.

posts.name: Tractionwave
posts.tagline: AI attention heatmaps for ads to check before you spend
posts.description: TractionWave evaluates ads and marketing visuals with AI attention prediction — a heatmap and ranked hotspots in seconds. Know it gets seen before the budget goes live.

posts.name: Udon
posts.tagline: Control deck for your Mac home server with AI sysadmin.
posts.description: Udon brings self-hosted apps, containers, storage, and monitoring together on your Mac mini or any Apple Silicon Mac. Manage it all from your browser, mobile companion or tell the built-in AI assistant what you need.

posts.name: Clippo
posts.tagline: Orchestrate AI agent teams on a visual canvas
posts.description: Stop drowning in terminal tabs. Clippo turns your software development into a visual command room on Windows. On an infinite canvas, connect agents like Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, CommandCode, Antigravity CLI, Kiro... simply by linking nodes to watch them code in parallel. Get on device memory to save tokens, native speed, and complete privacy with zero cloud or logins. Step up as tech lead of your own AI engineering team. Download Clippo now and take your workflow to the next level!

posts.name: offstage
posts.tagline: Your computer-use agent gets a Mac account, not your screen
posts.description: offstage gives Claude Code, Codex and opencode a second, logged-in macOS account to work in. Simulators, Xcode UI tests and the app your agent just built open on that account's desktop, so your screen, keyboard and mouse stay yours. Free and open source: https://github.com/viraatdas/offstage

posts.name: Side
posts.tagline: A little AI chat panel that lives beside your Mac's Dock
posts.description: Side is a tiny AI chat panel that sits right beside your Mac's Dock: one glance away, never in the way. • Fits the gap next to your Dock, floats above other windows, works across Spaces and full-screen apps • Switch providers, models and reasoning levels in one conversation • Bring your own account: sign in with ChatGPT or use an API key • Compact composer that expands to full height when needed • ⌘⇧Space to show or hide Free and open source (MIT).

posts.name: Tonefold
posts.tagline: Describe a song, get every part as editable MIDI
posts.description: Tonefold is a free, open-source AI music composer for macOS and Windows. Describe a song to Claude, get chords, melody, bass and drums in a piano roll you can edit note by note, then export MIDI, WAV and stems.

posts.name: judged.systems
posts.tagline: The judgment API platform for support systems.
posts.description: Support systems call judged.systems when a ticket needs a judgment. The helpdesk stays the system of record. You send the ticket. A pack defines the questions: queue, urgency, refund request, policy risk. Back comes a choice and its probabilities, a score on a rubric, or the probability a statement is true. Your thresholds return accept or review. A failed call stays in review. The ticket is redacted first. The evaluation is stored as it happened. A label on a miss leaves it untouched.

posts.name: Termaxa
posts.tagline: See what an AI agent's command would destroy before it runs
posts.description: A gate in the hook path of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot. It shows what a command would delete, backs it up first, and asks or refuses by your policy. Start in observe mode: nothing blocked, a report of what it would have caught. Open source, Rust.

posts.name: Mailwell
posts.tagline: Native Mac mail for IMAP, JMAP and Microsoft 365
posts.description: Mailwell is a native Mac mail app for people with more than one account. Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, Kagi Mail, Microsoft 365 and any IMAP or JMAP server share one unified inbox. Mail is stored on your Mac and syncs straight to your provider: no Mailwell servers, no tracking, no ads. Inbox tabs, rules, snooze, send later, and undo for everything. AI is optional and off by default. Turn on MCP and Claude can search your mail, read only.

posts.name: Isle Notch
posts.tagline: Lowweight minimal dynamic island for Windows
posts.description: Isle sits at the top of your screen. Closed, it's a small pill with a little face. It looks around, waves when you sign in, and hides in a game or a video. Hover or click and it opens. Music. Volume for each app. Clipboard. A timer, pomodoro, and today's calendar. Notes. Drop a file or a shortcut on it and open it later. Wi-Fi, brightness, night light. Battery, and a speed check. Stick it to the top or let it float. Change the color. If the face is too much, turn it off and keep the clock.

posts.name: ClawCall
posts.tagline: Your AI agent's phone to dial, hold, and reports back
posts.description: ClawCall makes real phone calls for you, from the AI you already use. Ask ChatGPT, Claude or a Grok bot to cancel a gym membership, get quotes from repair shops, or sit on hold with your insurer. It dials, works the phone tree, waits on hold, talks to whoever answers, and brings back what was said. When a decision needs you, it rings you first and connects you if you say yes like a real assistant. Free for 30 calls, no card. Then $4.99/mo flat.

posts.name: Semwright
posts.tagline: Give AI agents structured access to real software
posts.description: Semwright is an open-source Rust runtime for AI agents working with desktop and professional software. Through structured drivers, agents can interact with application objects and project data, while a shared runtime handles permissions, execution, dependencies, artifact handoffs, and verification. It supports MCP without being limited to a single protocol, model, or agent. Build workflows across applications without rebuilding the same integration infrastructure for each one.

posts.name: Typeling
posts.tagline: Translate in your iPhone keyboard. Keep your tone.
posts.description: Stay in the conversation, even when the language changes. Typeling translates in your iPhone keyboard with tones for friends, partners, and business. Preview your translation, then tap to replace your text. Translate into six languages, or paste an incoming message to read it in yours. Start with 50 free translations; top up with in-app credits when needed.

posts.name: Epilude Narrator
posts.tagline: Listen to any article, doc or text on your Mac
posts.description: Narrator reads selected text, documents, web pages, and images aloud on your Mac. Choose an on-device or cloud voice and follow every word.

posts.name: AgentGuard
posts.tagline: Scan AI agent Skills for risks before you install them
posts.description: AgentGuard scans AI agent SKILL.md files for security risks, hidden capabilities, and quality issues before you install them. Paste a Skill, get a Trust Report with scores, findings, and a clear verdict. Free to use — no account required.

posts.name: Simo
posts.tagline: The judgment layer for software that acts
posts.description: Simo is the System 1.5 judgment model from Temprl Labs. Ask typed questions about text, screenshots, or video and get calibrated probabilities and the values needed to act, in milliseconds.

posts.name: Hallmonitor
posts.tagline: See and answer every coding agent from your notch
posts.description: See every Claude Code and Codex session on your Mac and your servers, live: in the notch, menu bar, a native app and the terminal. Know who's done, who's stuck, and answer their questions right from the notch. Free and open source

posts.name: Drunken Penguins
posts.tagline: Party card games on everyone's phone. No app.
posts.description: Make a room, share a code, and everyone plays on their own phone. Secret votes, live results, no app and no sign-up to play. The Party Starter deck is free; extra packs are a one-time unlock. Plus Omi, the classic Sri Lankan card game.

posts.name: Moonwalkers Dusk
posts.tagline: Strap-on motorized wheels that let you walk twice as fast
posts.description: Discover Moonwalkers Dusk electric shoes by Shift Robotics. Our lightest robotic shoes yet, with three sizes, three finishes, and speeds up to 7 mph.

posts.name: Strac Comply
posts.tagline: Get SOC 2 without the sales call
posts.description: 1. Self-serve compliance automation. Sign up, connect AWS, Google Workspace, Okta, GitHub and Slack, and 100+ tests run continuously for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS and more. 2. No per-framework fees 3. 14-day free trial, no credit card 4. Built by a data-security company, so it also finds the AI apps and agents in your workspace and maps them to the customer data they can reach 5. Run it from the dashboard or Claude Code via MCP 6. Platform $4,995/yr. Audit, vCISO and pen test tiers above

posts.name: Chime
posts.tagline: Private SMS categorization that never leaves your device
posts.description: Chime automatically sorts your text messages into clean categories — OTPs, deliveries, promotions, banking, and personal — so you never dig through clutter again. Everything happens on-device, which means your messages stay private and never touch a server. No cloud, no accounts, no data harvesting. Just a quieter, organized inbox that works instantly and keeps your conversations yours. Set it up once and let Chime handle the noise.

posts.name: Revela
posts.tagline: A film camera for iPhone that makes you wait for the lab
posts.description: Revela is a film camera that lives in your phone. Pick a roll from a fridge of twelve original stocks, shoot it with no preview, then mail it to the lab and wait: an hour, overnight, or days. When the envelope arrives, pull the seal and see your photos for the first time. Prints develop from RAW with per-stock curves, grain and halation, and save to Photos at full resolution. Casual mode skips the wait. One price, no subscription, no account.

posts.name: Simple Workout Log
posts.tagline: The best minimalist workout tracker available
posts.description: A clear record of your training, with room for what matters. Simple Workout Log is a minimalist workout journal designed to help you note what you did and find your starting point next time. Set up your account and training preferences on the web. Log strength and cardio workouts on mobile, follow your routines, and keep your training history in one place.

posts.name: Ahem! Unmissable Meeting Reminders
posts.tagline: Full screen reminders for ADHD, time-blind & focused brains
posts.description: Most calendar apps assume you'll glance at them. Ahem! assumes you won't. On Mac and Windows, full-screen reminders interrupt deep focus, and one hotkey reveals your day. On iPhone, live countdowns, Lock Screen reminders and Dynamic Island nudges keep your next meeting in sight. Built for ADHD, time blindness and deep focus. Works with Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars. Available in 17 languages. Pay once per app, no subscription.

posts.name: aegis
posts.tagline: Smart personal safety app connected to 24/7 dispatch
posts.description: Aegis replaces friction-heavy panic buttons with an intelligent personal safety shield. When triggered, it links directly to 24/7 emergency dispatch while sharing a live context payload (real-time GPS, reason for alert, streaming audio/video, and vital health data) so responders never arrive blind. Built for everyday safety, it features Athena AI anomaly detection, fall detection, adaptive accessibility, and trusted contact networks.

posts.name: tunnl.gg
posts.tagline: Stable localhost URLs over SSH with no installs
posts.description: Most tunnels hand you a new URL every time. tunnl.gg gives you the same one: connect as stable@proxy.tunnl.gg and your SSH key becomes your identity, so your public HTTPS URL never changes. Register a webhook or OAuth callback once and forget it. Nothing to install, no account, works on any machine with SSH, with a QR code and live request log in your terminal. Free to use. Pro adds your own subdomains, no time limits and a request inspector. Open-source (MIT) server.

posts.name: pmtui
posts.tagline: Autopilot for long-running AI sessions in terminal
posts.description: pmtui focuses on managing multiple agents and solving long-horizon tasks. Autopilot does what an agent loop does, except loops drift once the work runs long. So pmtui keeps the loop outside the agent and rebuilds the prompt each time from your goal and the agent's own last status. You choose how often to check back, and it only surfaces what really needs your attention

posts.name: ProcBoss
posts.tagline: Run, deploy, monitor, and manage your apps across servers
posts.description: ProcBoss is a lightweight production process and infrastructure management platform for running, deploying, and monitoring applications across servers. Run Node.js, Bun, Deno, & other runtimes with clustering, automatic restarts, health checks, dependencies, cron jobs, logs, metrics, and GitHub auto-deployments. ProcBoss Cloud adds centralized server monitoring, deployment management, alerts, and hosted status pages; giving developers one place to keep production applications running reliably.

posts.name: Leanback
posts.tagline: Personal AI assistant for managing engineering teams
posts.description: Leanback is your personal AI assistant for managing engineering teams. It checks in with your team, reads every ticket and calendar, and delivers a clear action plan inside Slack, before your first coffee.

posts.name: SineFrame M3
posts.tagline: Test MCP servers and the agents that call them in pytest
posts.description: Your MCP unit tests pass, but did the agent call the tool? M3 runs your server through real Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Pi and asserts on the calls they actually made, in plain pytest. Direct tests need no API key. m3 ui shows every trace and tool call; m3 ci test --upload gates PRs and keeps runs on app.m3.sineframe.com. Open source, Apache-2.0.

posts.name: NumaClaw
posts.tagline: Deploy AI agents and autonomous AI companies in one click
posts.description: NumaClaw sets up OpenClaw and Paperclip AI for you two of the best opensource projects for running AI agents without any of the setup. Pick from 250+ ready-to-use OpenClaw agents or 26 fully autonomous PaperclipAI companies, or build your own custom agents and teams. Pick your agents or a ready-made AI company, connect your accounts, and everything is installed, running and yours about a minute later. Each agent gets a role, a budget and an off switch. Runs on your own machine, not a shared one.

posts.name: Kempt: Home Maintenance
posts.tagline: Home maintenance, on autopilot
posts.description: Kempt is the app I wish I had when I bought my first house. Kempt knows your appliances by model number, tracks what's due, and sends a Sunday Brief of what needs doing next: filters, gutters, freeze prep, and the small things nobody remembers until they're expensive. Live on the App Store now. $39.99 a year, 30 days free for Product Hunt users, link in the first comment.

posts.name: Coderblock
posts.tagline: Build full-stack web apps with your own AI team.
posts.description: Coderblock.ai lets anyone build production-ready full-stack web apps with a team of specialized AI employees. Autonomous agents and dynamic model selection use the right AI for each task, while ready-to-use templates help you launch faster and reduce AI costs.

posts.name: AI Fundraising Agent
posts.tagline: 24/7 agent that finds and pitches investors while you sleep
posts.description: We've built an app that helps you find investors while you sleep. Enter your website and AI researches your company, finds your competitors and identifies the most relevant investor segments. Then it searches our database of 125,000+ angels and VCs, ranks the strongest matches and writes personalized emails and follow-ups. It asks for your approval and you're good to go. The whole process takes about 30 seconds.

posts.name: Loop small wins to achieve bigger goals
posts.tagline: Start and complete goals with friends & family
posts.description: Achievement runs on five loops: time, doing, being seen, learning, and timed dopamine. Together they build the habit and a new story about who you are and what you can do. Loops runs all five on purpose, then stops them from breaking. Write the first paragraph, not the chapter. Some progress counts as done. Four rest days a month, so one bad day doesn't end a streak. A buddy who cheers. Dora, an AI coach who knows your goals and never judges. Built for ADHD. It was the highest bar.

posts.name: Solofounders.help
posts.tagline: You shipped the app. You still don't have a sale
posts.description: Paste your product URL for a free diagnosis of your offer, buyer, sales blockers, You shipped the app. You still don't have a sale. Paste the URL. Built by founders who already sold, it was put together by a small group of entrepreneurs, not a content team. People who took projects past $100M in mcap, sold companies above $10M, and spent years mentoring inside accelerators. The scan and the writing are done by a machine. The method - who to pick, what to say, when to ask for money - is theirs.

posts.name: Bridge
posts.tagline: Video conferencing for the agentic era
posts.description: Bridge replaces legacy video conferencing and disparate meeting tools with one collaborative platform for humans and AI agents. With Bridge, you can host video conferencing calls, capture conversations on other platforms, collaborate with AI agents, get meeting preparation and notetaking, build structured memory automatically, access meeting context using our MCP, and much more. For the first time in history, people and AI agents can meet and work together as true collaborators.

posts.name: SEOSage
posts.tagline: Desktop SEO crawler with no page limits. Yes, really.
posts.description: SEOSage is a desktop SEO crawler for Mac and Windows. Paste a link and it visits every page, with no page limit, then shows a health score and the issues to fix: broken pages, missing meta descriptions, noindex tags and more. Fix an issue, re-check it, and turn the results into a client-ready report, so no more pasting screenshots into slides at midnight. Built for anyone doing SEO: site owners, in-house teams, freelancers and agencies. Try it free for 14 days.

posts.name: Abejas
posts.tagline: Your professional network. This time, it’s personal.
posts.description: Organize your professional network, keep private notes, and remember to follow up. Abejas is a native app for Mac and iPhone. One purchase, no subscription.

posts.name: Brandmade.click
posts.tagline: Build Your Own E-commerce Store Today!
posts.description: Build your own brand with Brandmade.click. Find white-label products, add your branding, create an online store, manage shipping, generate AI content, and grow your business from one platform.

posts.name: call4me
posts.tagline: Give your AI agent one new tool: make a phone call
posts.description: call4me lets Claude, Codex, ChatGPT and any MCP agent call businesses for you. It navigates phone trees and hold music, handles the conversation, asks you when it needs help, takes callbacks, and returns the result, transcript and recording.

posts.name: PartnerMe AI
posts.tagline: Warm intros, posts, replies and boosts run by five AI agents
posts.description: PartnerMe AI is a business network ecosystem platform run by five AI agents. Tell the matchmaking agent who you need: a co-founder, an investor, a client, a professional, an influencer. It searches members, your LinkedIn connections and thousands of curated leads, makes a warm intro both sides approve, and books the meeting. The other agents post in your voice, reply to comments and DMs, and boost your community's posts in the first hour. You approve every action. Free plan available forever.

posts.name: Fresh Jots
posts.tagline: Private, tamper-evident logs for your AI and scripts
posts.description: Private, tamper-evident notes for your AI sessions, scripts and agents. Write over MCP, REST or one curl; a hook archives Claude Code and Codex sessions. Every note is Bitcoin-anchored, so you can prove it never changed. Free to start.

posts.name: UI Context for Agents
posts.tagline: Better UI Context for your agents. in No Time.
posts.description: A Chrome extension. Click an element on a page, type what should change, and copy one prompt with its selector, component and source file for your coding agent.

posts.name: dotstore.io
posts.tagline: the "app-store" for web apps, saas, devtools and much more.
posts.description: Discover the best web apps: productivity, design, AI, developer tools and more. Curated, ranked, and ready to open in any browser. No installs, no downloads. MRR and analytics tracked.

posts.name: Sodabase
posts.tagline: Find and fix broken Supabase tables.
posts.description: Agents break things all the time. Sodabase catches it when they break your Supabase app. It learns how your tables normally update, spots problems, and helps you fix them. Just connect your project and let it monitor the situation.

posts.name: IllyVoIP V2
posts.tagline: Business calling, AI voice agents and SMS in one workspace
posts.description: Bring business calls, phone numbers, SMS and AI voice agents into one workspace. Use the web portal or iOS, Android and Windows apps, manage team call handling, and connect your workflows with SIP and APIs.

posts.name: Kanbanto
posts.tagline: One task board for your team and their AI agents
posts.description: A Trello-style kanban board where your team and their AI agents work from the same plan. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent: it turns emails and notes into tasks, picks up the next one, does the work and reports on the card, not in a chat you'll lose. You see where everything stands and decide what's done. Run projects, sales, support or store orders on it, with timelines, time logging and custom fields. Free with the AI you already have: no per-seat price, no AI credits. Self-hostable.

posts.name: Sphere
posts.tagline: Modern Bookkeeping Software Relaunch [Low Invoice Fees!]
posts.description: Hey PH! Super excited to be here relaunching Sphere. Sphere is modern bookkeeping software for small businesses. We're growing now with customers & revenue. Our ACH fee for online payment processing for invoices is 0.8% ($20 max cap) vs. QuickBooks/Wave's 1% no max cap. We're powered by Stripe! Manage your books, generate financial reports, create invoices, collect payments, stay tax-ready, all with ease. Starting at $25/month. There's also a free plan! We've also included a PH discount code.

posts.name: VersionDB
posts.tagline: Find Your Customers By Their Technologies
posts.description: VersionDB is a technographic and contact database that helps you find customers by the technologies they use. It crawls over 50 million websites and detects stacks across CMSs, ecommerce, analytics, payments, and more, then pairs them with on-site contact details and social profiles. The Lead List Exporter delivers a CSV by email with no subscriptions or accounts required.

posts.name: Ventilo
posts.tagline: AI agent that turn one sentence into a live ticketing page
posts.description: Stop filling in setup forms to sell tickets. Ventilo is an AI event builder for organizers: describe your event in one sentence and it builds the real ticketing for you (event page, date, venue, capacity and prices) as a draft you approve or edit. It asks only for what is missing, and everything is created on the Ventilo platform, ready to publish. Go from "Jazz night, Nov 14, 300 seats at €35" to tickets on sale in minutes. Ticketing is live today, and a new capability ships every week.

posts.name: Sharpy
posts.tagline: To-do list that keeps itself current
posts.description: Sharpy is a to-do list that keeps itself current. It watches your screen, connects to your apps, and organizes your day. Someone asks you for something in Slack? Sharpy creates a task. You make a promise? Sharpy remembers and reminds you. Task completed? Sharpy checks it off. It gives you the environment to stay focused without constantly thinking what's next.

posts.name: ScanPatra
posts.tagline: Your all-in-one document scanner and PDF toolkit
posts.description: ScanPatra is an all-in-one document workspace for students, journalists, professionals, and businesses. Scan documents, extract text with OCR, create and edit PDFs, organize files, add signatures, and draft letters—all from one app. Built with a privacy-first approach and designed to reduce the need for multiple document apps, ScanPatra helps you scan, manage, and work with documents faster and more efficiently.

posts.name: AI Promo Design
posts.tagline: An AI chat that designs your merch and takes the order
posts.description: Describe a shirt, hoodie or mug in one sentence and Remi, our AI designer, shows a print-ready design on the real item. Change it by asking. Team shirts can each carry their own name and number, like a jersey, with the lettering free. Send the group one link and everyone enters their own size from a phone. Free picture tools clean up a logo. Then check out in the same chat: AI from A to Z, free to design, no minimum, printed in the US, free US shipping.

posts.name: Figlend
posts.tagline: Lend your Figma tokens to your team and build together
posts.description: Your teammate has Figma AI credits. You have the next idea. Figlend connects your tabs on the same Make file or Design page so your prompts can run through their account. Drag Figlend to your bookmarks bar, open the same Figma Make/Design file page as your teammate, and pair with a PIN. Send prompts to their tab and build using their AI tokens.

posts.name: Goals.com
posts.tagline: AI-powered CRM built to drive sales performance
posts.description: Goals.com goes beyond traditional CRM by turning sales data into action. It combines CRM, AI sales coaching, pipeline intelligence, forecasting, goal setting and performance tracking in one platform. Instead of simply showing teams what happened, Goals.com helps reps understand what to do next, helps managers identify opportunities and risks, and keeps everyone focused on the activities and outcomes that drive sales performance.

posts.name: Words for the Wind
posts.tagline: A virtual wind phone
posts.description: Words for the Wind is a free, private virtual wind phone. Write what you never got to say to someone you've lost, press release, and watch your words blur away on the wind. Nothing is saved or sent. No accounts, no tracking, just a quiet place to speak.

posts.name: Equofi — Family Finance, Simplified
posts.tagline: The family finance app that never owns your data.
posts.description: Equofi: family finance, private by design. • Your data lives in your own Google Drive, not our servers • On-device Private AI, so nothing leaves your phone • Scan receipts into itemised transactions • Family budgets and spend tracking • Split bills with friends and family • Add expenses by voice • Sync Gmail, Outlook or IMAP • Share receipts into Equofi from any app • Advanced spending analytics • Manage multiple families in one app

posts.name: LayerNext
posts.tagline: AI Agents for Finance Operations
posts.description: LayerNext is an AI agent platform for accounts payable automation and finance operations. Agents capture, validate, match to PO, exception-handle, post, and reconcile invoices end to end, with human approval and full audit trails. Works via desktop and legacy systems, no API needed. Covers AP automation, bank reconciliation, bookkeeping, and CFO-level reporting. Compatible with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics 365, and custom ERPs.

posts.name: Nosso Imposto
posts.tagline: Brazil's public records, finally in the same room
posts.description: Brazil publishes almost everything: candidates, company partners, contracts, sanctions, budget amendments, official gazettes. It's spread over 20+ government sites in formats nobody reads. Nosso Imposto puts it in one map, one graph and one page per name. Free, no login.

posts.name: Keryx
posts.tagline: AI research with verifiable sources and creator rewards
posts.description: Keryx is an open-source research agent. Ask a question, set a budget, and follow BUY/SKIP/CACHE decisions. Inspect source excerpts, citations, article versions and payment receipts. Eligible, evidence-verified citations can reward creators in USDC on Arc mainnet. Free public references stay free. Use the web, MCP or API. Early access: gaps and incomplete answers are explicit. The video shows an earlier Arc-testnet build; screenshots show the current app.

posts.name: Vuenia
posts.tagline: Podcasts, videos and courses produced by AI, directed by you
posts.description: Most AI content tools turn one prompt into a black-box result. Vuenia gives you a team of agents (researcher, scriptwriter, narrator, slide designer, video editor, publisher) in a pipeline you can see and steer. Step in anywhere: approve the outline, rewrite a line, swap a voice. Verification agents check facts and dates before you review. Bring your own API keys at no markup, see the cost of every step, schedule runs, and publish podcasts and videos straight to YouTube.

posts.name: UX Pilot Labs
posts.tagline: Free tools for gradients, textures, visual effects and more.
posts.description: Create gradients, textures, ASCII art, halftone and 3D effects with 16 free browser-based design tools. Start with a preset, tweak it with live controls, and preview your work in landing pages, cards and mobile layouts. When you find a direction you like, export it or use it as a starting point on the UX Pilot canvas. Exploring is free; exporting and using the canvas require a free UX Pilot account.

posts.name: Bundle Studio by Brandergy
posts.tagline: Shopify bundles, discounts and analytics in one app
posts.description: Let Shopify shoppers build their own bundles. Set fixed prices or tiered discounts and review bundle orders in one app. Standard adds scheduling, product pairings and consented funnel insights. Advanced adds required products and free gifts. Plans from US$9.99/month with a 30-day free trial.

posts.name: PitchMagic
posts.tagline: Speak fluent investor
posts.description: Like having a friend who's a venture capitalist read your deck before you send it. Upload it and get a score out of 100, the exact words to change on every slide, and the 3 fixes that matter most, built on the frameworks YC, Sequoia, a16z and Benchmark have published. The first preview is free.

posts.name: YT AI Studio
posts.tagline: From script to finished YouTube video, on your Mac
posts.description: YT AI Studio is a native macOS app that takes you from script to finished YouTube video. Write with AI assistance, rehearse with a teleprompter, record your takes, and let the studio direct the edit: storyboard, pacing, motion graphics, captions, mixed audio. Render in 1080p or hand off to DaVinci Resolve, then generate titles, thumbnails, chapters, and upload to YouTube with your approval. The free edition is $0 and source-available. Premium is $249 one-time, $49 for the first 50.

posts.name: aityx
posts.tagline: AI Decisions with numbers, dates and explicit logic
posts.description: Jev changed the AI model landscape by introducing what became known as AI Decisions. We’re taking that idea even further. aityx launches with Jev support and extends AI decisions beyond classification with numbers, dates, expressions and explicit decision logic, while keeping the full result traceable and explainable.

posts.name: Social Undertone
posts.tagline: Understand a creator's audience, straight from the comments
posts.description: Influencer tools count followers and likes. Social Undertone reads the comments. It turns the public comments on a creator's Instagram and TikTok posts into an audience report: sentiment, trust, bots and spam, buying interest, reactions to sponsored posts, the questions people keep asking and the brands they name. Built for brands choosing partners and creators showing their worth. Start with 3 free reports.

posts.name: Rightly
posts.tagline: Supercharge your macOS Finder context menu
posts.description: Rightly supercharges your macOS Finder right-click menu. Instantly create files (10+ formats, custom templates), compress/extract (30+ formats with encryption), and access favorite folders/apps. Includes handy tools: copy paths, toggle extensions, AirDrop, and open terminals. Perfect for developers, office users, and designers to eliminate repetitive steps and boost efficiency. Download Rightly and make every right-click count!

posts.name: Trace
posts.tagline: 10 big things in tech & AI, every day
posts.description: Every day, Trace picks 10 big things happening in tech and AI. It find the stories across 400+ sources, explain what happened in a few lines, and link to the originals if you want to go deeper. Catch up in minutes, then get on with your day.

posts.name: Hexowatch OR:ON
posts.tagline: Tell it what to watch. It tells you what changed.
posts.description: OR:ON watches public web pages and tells you when the part you care about changes, and what it changed to. Paste a link and say what matters in plain words: "tell me when the price drops." Alerts read like "Pro plan price changed from $49 to $39," with before and after side by side. Ask OR:ON, or connect Claude or ChatGPT, about your change history. Built on 5+ years of Hexowatch, with a 10x higher success rate opening pages. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: OhMyBug
posts.tagline: Catch bugs your AI coding agent missed
posts.description: Your claude writes the code. Ours tries to break it. OhMyBug checks your final diff before merge with a panel of independent AI models that hunt for bugs. Your own Claude Code or Codex verifies each finding against your repo, and you approve the verdicts. Pay $10 flat per review only when a medium-or-higher bug is confirmed. Clean reviews, false positives, unclear findings, and minor-only issues cost $0. Your first bug-finding review is free, with no card required.

posts.name: Decato
posts.tagline: AI that replaces the interior designer. Plan in, home out.
posts.description: Decato replaces the interior designer. Not the taste: the month of work and the markup. Drop in a floor plan or describe the room; our own model reads it to ±10 cm. Name a budget and an agent furnishes every room from real products that fit, checked against your walls before anything lands. Every piece rendered at its exact size, no hallucinated furniture. Out: a purchase order, not a moodboard. Free for Mac on your own ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini key.

posts.name: Google AI Edge Foresight
posts.tagline: Scribbles to complete meeting notes with on-device AI
posts.description: Google AI Edge Foresight is a companion app for virtual and in-person meetings that uses AI to transform quick meeting scribbles to thorough notes. It also helps ensure you always have the information you need with multimodal search and retrieval powered by the new EmbeddingGemma 2 model. Live Q&A automatically detects questions in dialog and answers them from your personal files. AI models run completely on-device without limits, connectivity, or subscription cost.

posts.name: Closign.io
posts.tagline: Describe a contract, AI prepares it, everyone signs
posts.description: Closign lets you create, send and sign business documents in minutes. Describe what you need and AI drafts it, or upload a PDF and AI finds where to sign. OTP-verified signing, signing order and a full audit certificate. Simple plans, no per-document fees.

posts.name: Runtile
posts.tagline: A year in review for your runs that never leaves your iPhone
posts.description: Runtile turns the runs already in Apple Health into a clear picture: a heatmap with one tile per day, personal bests from 1 km to the marathon, shoe mileage and your week, month and year at a glance. New: Year in Review replays your year tile by tile, then shows your biggest month, longest run, new bests and the shoes that did the work. Works with Apple Watch, Strava, Garmin and any app that writes to Health. No account, nothing leaves your phone.

posts.name: Entrig
posts.tagline: Notification Layer for Supabase
posts.description: Send notifications for your apps that use Supabase as the backend, without any backend setup. Start sending in just 3 steps: 1. Connect your Supabase 2. Configure your channels 3. Create notifications Auth emails are handled out of the box. Just enable them and you're done. The simplest notification solution built specifically for Supabase apps.

posts.name: BauBudget
posts.tagline: Still on budget? Which trade to cut? PDF for the bank.
posts.description: BauBudget shows private home builders whether the build budget still holds — on track, tight, or critical — and which trade is over budget. Export a budget report PDF for the bank. German UI, euros. Data on-device; iCloud optional. iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: BustimeFinder
posts.tagline: Live bus maps, timetables, and the story behind each journey
posts.description: Find your bus and see how its journey is going. Explore live maps, routes, timetables and vehicle records. Check available “Running on time” or “Running late” statuses, compare “Plan” with “Seen at stop”, and see approximate passages marked ≈. Check the last mapped time and data source. Free, no sign-up. 45,267 service records, 1,240 operator records and supported places in 15 countries (5 October snapshot). Published UK liveries where available. Coverage and live detail vary.

posts.name: Mevali
posts.tagline: Project management without process theater
posts.description: Mevali is lightweight project management software that stays out of the way and helps teams identify, shape, and plan the most impactful work for user personas.

posts.name: Gravo
posts.tagline: Find customers the moment they ask for what you sell
posts.description: People are already asking for what you sell — in chats, groups, forums, and comments. Gravo finds those requests the moment they appear and lets you respond right there, in their language, using your own accounts. No cold outreach. No ads. Just relevant people who are already looking for a solution like yours — including in closed groups and communities.

posts.name: Out of the Blue
posts.tagline: Who have you been meaning to call?
posts.description: A private way to reconnect. Build a call list, make one blind call, and find out who answered only if they pick up.

posts.name: Emerge Care
posts.tagline: Your after-visit health AI companion
posts.description: Emerge Care for iPhone keeps track of how you feel, explains it in plain words with sources, and gets you ready for every appointment.
